e.body:
**bancassurance-analytics** 是一个**土耳其语的一体化银行保险（bancassurance）分析项目**（仓库 `SultanKus/Bancassurance-Analytics-Project`），**实测 ★1、fork 0、主语言 Jupyter Notebook、仓库体量 275 KB、创建于 2026-08-31、最后推送 2026-09-01**（**均 GitHub API 实测值**）；**⚠️ 该仓库实测无任何许可文件（`NONE`）、且无 topics**。本条目属于本轮主题**「我是什么、我不是什么、我做到哪一步」**——**它的贡献在于**逐模块标注完成状态****。

可核实信息（**均 README 逐字实测，2,039 字节**）：**README 逐字标题为「Bancassurance-Analytics-Project」**，**副题逐字为土耳其语**：**「Bütünleşik Finansal Risk Yönetimi: Kredi Skorlama, Aktüeryal Fiyatlama ve Erken Uyarı (Churn) Sistemleri üzerine matematiksel ve istatistiksel modelleme serisi.」**——**即「一体化金融风险管理：关于信贷评分、精算定价与流失预警系统的数学与统计建模系列」**。⭐ **其正文逐字说明了项目范围与自我定位**：**「Bu proje, bir müşterinin kredi riskinden başlayıp, sigorta (kasko) fiyatlamasına ve son olarak müşteri kaybı (churn) erken uyarı sistemine kadar uzanan uçtan uca bir makine öğrenmesi ve istatistiksel modelleme serisidir.」**——**「本项目是一条端到端的机器学习与统计建模序列，从一个客户的信贷风险开始，延伸到保险（kasko，即车损险）定价，最后到客户流失（churn）早期预警系统」**；⭐ **并逐字声明其方法取向**：**「Standart metriklerin ötesine geçerek, gerçek dünyadaki finansal dengesizlikleri matematiksel bir yaklaşımla çözmeyi hedefler.」**——**「它力求超越标准指标，用数学方法解决真实世界中的金融不平衡问题」**。⭐ **模块状态逐字实测**：**「Modül 1: Kredi Skorlamada Dengesiz Veri Tuzağı (Tamamlandı)」——模块一「信贷评分中的不平衡数据陷阱」标注为 **Tamamlandı（已完成）****；**其模块一说明逐字给出目标与问题**：**目标是计算车贷申请中的违约（坏账）风险，问题是坏账在数据集中占比极低、约 **%8（8%）****。（**其余模块本次仅读到 README 的 2,039 字节为止，未读到完整模块清单，故不转述**。）

对 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 它填上了本词条所在站点形态普查中长期为**真空白（0）**的「bancassurance/银保」组，但必须紧接着说明：**这**不等于**该形态已被覆盖****——**这是一个 ★1、README 仅 2,039 字节、以土耳其语写作的个人建模项目**，**它证明的是「GitHub 上银保相关的建模实践确实存在且可被检索到」，而不是「本站已有一条有分量的银保条目」**；**⚠️ 本词条据此明确提醒：普查读数由 0 变为 1 之后，**下一轮不应据此认为银保形态已填****（**这是第 317 轮「n 偏小 ≠ 该形态真的空」的**镜像**结论：n 变 1 ≠ 该形态已被覆盖**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「一体化」这一设计本身与银保的业务逻辑相合**——**银保的实质是**同一个客户在银行与保险两侧的风险与价值被合并管理****，**而该项目把「信贷违约风险 → 车险定价 → 流失预警」串成一条链，正好对应这个逻辑**；**可与池内 [[scorecardpy]]（信用评分卡工具）、[[insurance-uplift]]（增益建模）、[[easy-glm]]、[[insurance-thin-data]] 并读**：**其中 [[insurance-thin-data]] 与本项目「不平衡数据陷阱」这一主题最接近**（**本次未读其方法正文，故不转述其用了何种不平衡处理技术**）。**③ ⭐ 「超越标准指标」是一句值得注意的自我要求**——**在违约率仅约 8% 的极度不平衡数据上，准确率等标准指标会给出误导性的好看结果**，**这与本站反复强调的「数字看起来好 ≠ 结论可靠」是同一件事**（**⚠️ 其具体做法本次未读，故不转述**）。**④ ⭐ 逐模块标注完成状态（Tamamlandı）是**弱版本**的「我做到哪一步」**——**它至少让读者知道模块一已完成、其余状态需自行判断**；**⚠️ 但本次只读到 2,039 字节，**未能确认是否存在完整模块清单及各模块状态**，**故本词条不主张「所有模块状态均已标注」**。**⑤ ⭐ kasko（土耳其语车损险）这一险种名值得记一笔**——**可与池内 [[fremtpl2]]（法国车险数据集）、[[higson-motor-insurance-demo]]、[[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]]、[[car-damage-assessment-ai]] 并读：**车险定价与车损评估在多个辖区都是建模主战场****。

⚠️ **如实标注**：**① ⚠️ 该仓库实测**无任何许可文件**（`NONE`）**——**本词条明确记录，并提示使用其代码或方法前应自行确认授权状况**；**② ⭐⭐ 本条目是**弱候选**，收录理由是**填补一个真空白形态并如实标注其分量**，**而非因为它本身有分量**——**★1、fork 0、README 仅 2,039 字节、无 topics、无许可**，**本词条明确不主张其质量、完整性、方法正确性或教学价值**；**③** 本次核实的是**仓库元数据与 README 全文（2,039 字节）的标题、副题、项目范围、方法取向与模块一状态**，⭐ **但未读完整模块清单、未打开任何 Jupyter Notebook、未运行任何代码、未查看其数据来源**，因此**不能转述其数据、特征工程、模型选择、不平衡处理技术、任何结果指标或模块二以后的任何内容**；**④ ⭐ 「坏账约占 8%」为**README 自述值**，**本次未核对数据**；**⑤ 项目已完成到什么程度无法判断**——**README 只明确标注了模块一为已完成**，**其余模块是否存在、是否完成本次未核实**；**⑥ 数据来源、是否使用真实数据、是否涉及个人数据、合规状态本次均未核实**（**本词条据此不主张其数据可复用或符合任何隐私要求**）；**⑦ 土耳其语项目对本站读者的**直接可用性有限****——**本词条如实标注其语言，不主张存在中文或英文版本**（**本次未核实是否有其他语言材料**）；**⑧** 本词条**不主张**该项目适用于任何真实的银保业务或定价决策**。**核实说明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/SultanKus/Bancassurance-Analytics-Project` 与 `/readme` 于 2026-09-11 经 GitHub API 实测读取（README 2,039 字节，土耳其语原文逐字节录并附中文对译）；**未打开任何 notebook、未运行代码**。

e.body_en:
**bancassurance-analytics** is **an integrated Turkish-language bancassurance analytics project** (repository `SultanKus/Bancassurance-Analytics-Project`), with **measured ★1, 0 forks, Jupyter Notebook as the primary language, a 275 KB repository, created 2026-08-31 and last pushed 2026-09-01** (**all GitHub API measurements**); **⚠️ the repository measurably has no licence file (`NONE`) and no topics**. It belongs to this round’s theme of "what this is, what it is not, how far it got" — **its contribution is labelling each module’s completion status**.

Verifiable details (**all read verbatim from the 2,039-byte README**): the **README’s title reads verbatim "Bancassurance-Analytics-Project"**, with the **subtitle verbatim in Turkish**: **"Bütünleşik Finansal Risk Yönetimi: Kredi Skorlama, Aktüeryal Fiyatlama ve Erken Uyarı (Churn) Sistemleri üzerine matematiksel ve istatistiksel modelleme serisi."** — **"Integrated financial risk management: a series of mathematical and statistical modelling on credit scoring, actuarial pricing and churn early-warning systems."** ⭐ **Its body states the scope and self-positioning verbatim**: **"Bu proje, bir müşterinin kredi riskinden başlayıp, sigorta (kasko) fiyatlamasına ve son olarak müşteri kaybı (churn) erken uyarı sistemine kadar uzanan uçtan uca bir makine öğrenmesi ve istatistiksel modelleme serisidir."** — **an end-to-end machine-learning and statistical modelling series running from a client’s credit risk through motor (kasko) pricing to a churn early-warning system**; ⭐ **and its methodological stance verbatim**: **"Standart metriklerin ötesine geçerek, gerçek dünyadaki finansal dengesizlikleri matematiksel bir yaklaşımla çözmeyi hedefler."** — **it aims to go beyond standard metrics and tackle real-world financial imbalance mathematically**. ⭐ **Module status read verbatim**: **"Modül 1: Kredi Skorlamada Dengesiz Veri Tuzağı (Tamamlandı)"** — module one, "the imbalanced-data trap in credit scoring", is labelled **Tamamlandı (completed)**; **its module-one description states the goal as computing default risk on vehicle-loan applications and the problem as defaults being only about 8% (%8) of the dataset**. (**Only the 2,039 bytes of README were read, so the full module list is not restated.**)

For RIAA: **① ⭐⭐ It fills the "bancassurance" group that has long been a true zero in this site’s form census — but this must be immediately qualified: it does not mean the form is covered** — **this is a ★1 personal modelling project with a 2,039-byte README written in Turkish**; **what it demonstrates is that bancassurance modelling practice exists on GitHub and is findable, not that this site now holds a substantial bancassurance entry**; **⚠️ the entry therefore warns explicitly that a census reading moving from 0 to 1 should not lead the next round to treat the bancassurance form as filled** (**the mirror of round 317’s "a small n does not mean the form is truly empty": n becoming 1 does not mean the form is covered**). **② ⭐⭐ The "integrated" design itself matches the business logic of bancassurance** — **bancassurance really means one client’s risk and value being managed jointly across the bank and insurance sides**, **and chaining credit default risk, motor pricing and churn warning into one sequence corresponds to exactly that**; **readable with [[scorecardpy]] (credit scorecards), [[insurance-uplift]] (uplift modelling), [[easy-glm]] and [[insurance-thin-data]]** — **of these, [[insurance-thin-data]] is closest to its "imbalanced-data trap" theme** (**its method body was not read, so no imbalance technique is restated**). **③ ⭐ "Beyond standard metrics" is a notable self-requirement** — **on data with roughly 8% default rate, standard metrics such as accuracy give misleadingly good results**, **the same point this site keeps making: numbers looking good does not mean the conclusion is sound** (**its specific approach was not read**). **④ ⭐ Labelling each module’s status (Tamamlandı) is a weak version of "how far I got"** — **at least it tells the reader module one is complete while leaving the rest to be judged**; **⚠️ but only 2,039 bytes were read, so whether a complete module list and statuses exist could not be confirmed, and the entry does not claim all statuses are labelled**. **⑤ ⭐ The term kasko (Turkish motor own-damage cover) is worth noting** — **readable with [[fremtpl2]] (a French motor dataset), [[higson-motor-insurance-demo]], [[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]] and [[car-damage-assessment-ai]]: motor pricing and damage assessment are a modelling battleground across jurisdictions**.

⚠️ **Stated plainly**: **① ⚠️ The repository measurably has no licence file** (`NONE`) — **recorded explicitly, with the advice to confirm authorisation before using its code or methods**; **② ⭐⭐ This is a weak candidate, collected to fill a true-zero form while labelling its weight honestly, not because it is substantial in itself** — **★1, 0 forks, a 2,039-byte README, no topics, no licence**; **the entry claims no quality, completeness, methodological correctness or teaching value**; **③** this check verified **the repository metadata and the README’s 2,039 bytes in respect of its title, subtitle, scope, methodological stance and module-one status**, ⭐ **but did not read the full module list, open any Jupyter Notebook, run any code or inspect its data sources**, so **its data, feature engineering, model choice, imbalance handling, any result metric, and anything after module two cannot be restated**; **④ ⭐ "Defaults are about 8%" is a README self-report**, **not checked against data**; **⑤ how far the project is actually complete cannot be judged** — **the README explicitly marks only module one as completed**, **and whether other modules exist or are done was not verified**; **⑥ data sources, whether real data is used, whether personal data is involved, and compliance status were not verified** (**so no reusability or privacy compliance is claimed**); **⑦ a Turkish-language project has limited direct usability for this site’s readers** — **stated plainly, with no claim that Chinese or English versions exist** (**other language material was not checked**); **⑧** the entry **does not claim the project is suitable for any real bancassurance business or pricing decision**. **Verification note**: `https://api.github.com/repos/SultanKus/Bancassurance-Analytics-Project` and `/readme` were read via the GitHub API on 2026-09-11 (the 2,039-byte README, with the Turkish original quoted verbatim and glossed in Chinese); **no notebook opened, no code run**.

可核實資訊（**均 README 逐字實測，2,039 位元組**）：**逐字標題「Bancassurance-Analytics-Project」**，**副題逐字為土耳其語**：**「Bütünleşik Finansal Risk Yönetimi: Kredi Skorlama, Aktüeryal Fiyatlama ve Erken Uyarı (Churn) Sistemleri üzerine matematiksel ve istatistiksel modelleme serisi.」**——**即「一體化金融風險管理：關於信貸評分、精算定價與流失預警系統的數學與統計建模系列」**。⭐ **正文逐字說明範圍**：**「…uçtan uca bir makine öğrenmesi ve istatistiksel modelleme serisidir.」**——**「一條端到端的機器學習與統計建模序列，從客戶的信貸風險開始，延伸到保險（kasko，車損險）定價，最後到客戶流失早期預警系統」**；⭐ **方法取向逐字**：**「Standart metriklerin ötesine geçerek, gerçek dünyadaki finansal dengesizlikleri matematiksel bir yaklaşımla çözmeyi hedefler.」**——**「力求超越標準指標，用數學方法解決真實世界中的金融不平衡問題」**。⭐ **模組狀態逐字**：**「Modül 1: Kredi Skorlamada Dengesiz Veri Tuzağı (Tamamlandı)」**——**模組一標註為 **Tamamlandı（已完成）****；**其說明逐字指出目標為計算車貸申請的違約風險、問題為壞賬在數據集中僅約 **%8（8%）****。

對 RIAA：**① ⭐⭐ 它填上了本站形態普查中長期為**真空白（0）**的「bancassurance/銀保」組，但必須緊接說明：**這**不等於**該形態已被覆蓋****——**這是一個 ★1、README 僅 2,039 位元組、以土耳其語寫作的個人建模項目**；**⚠️ 本詞條據此明確提醒：普查讀數由 0 變 1 之後，**下一輪不應據此認為銀保形態已填****（**這是第 317 輪「n 偏小 ≠ 該形態真的空」的**鏡像**結論**）。**② ⭐⭐ 「一體化」這一設計本身與銀保的業務邏輯相合**——**銀保的實質是**同一個客戶在銀行與保險兩側的風險與價值被合併管理****（可與 [[scorecardpy]]、[[insurance-uplift]]、[[easy-glm]]、[[insurance-thin-data]] 並讀——**其中 [[insurance-thin-data]] 與本項目「不平衡數據陷阱」主題最接近**）。**③ ⭐ 「超越標準指標」是一句值得注意的自我要求**——**在違約率僅約 8% 的極度不平衡數據上，準確率等標準指標會給出誤導性的好看結果**（**⚠️ 其具體做法本次未讀**）。**④ ⭐ 逐模組標註完成狀態（Tamamlandı）是**弱版本**的「我做到哪一步」**；**⚠️ 但本次只讀到 2,039 位元組，未能確認是否存在完整模組清單及各模組狀態**。**⑤ ⭐ kasko（土耳其語車損險）這一險種名值得記一筆**（可與 [[fremtpl2]]、[[higson-motor-insurance-demo]]、[[yolo11m-car-damage-detector]]、[[car-damage-assessment-ai]] 並讀）。

⚠️ **如實標注**：**① ⚠️ 該倉庫實測**無任何許可文件****——**明確記錄，並提示使用其代碼或方法前應自行確認授權**；**② ⭐⭐ 本條目是**弱候選**，收錄理由是**填補一個真空白形態並如實標註其分量**，**而非因為它本身有分量**——**★1、fork 0、README 僅 2,039 位元組、無 topics、無許可**；**本詞條明確不主張其質量、完整性、方法正確性或教學價值**；**③** 本次核實到**倉庫元數據與 README 全文（2,039 位元組）的標題、副題、範圍、方法取向與模組一狀態**，⭐ **但未讀完整模組清單、未打開任何 Jupyter Notebook、未運行代碼、未查看數據來源**；**④ ⭐ 「壞賬約佔 8%」為**README 自述值**，未核對數據**；**⑤ 項目完成到什麼程度無法判斷**——**README 只明確標註模組一已完成**；**⑥ 數據來源、是否使用真實數據、是否涉及個人數據、合規狀態均未核實**；**⑦ 土耳其語項目對本站讀者的**直接可用性有限****——**如實標註其語言，不主張存在中文或英文版本**；**⑧** 本詞條**不主張**該項目適用於任何真實的銀保業務或定價決策**。**核實說明**：`https://api.github.com/repos/SultanKus/Bancassurance-Analytics-Project` 與 `/readme` 於 2026-09-11 經 GitHub API 實測讀取；**未打開任何 notebook、未運行代碼**。
